_note: The Ember Courts, level 11: fire, and a court to please. See docs/zones.md.

ember_courts.name: the Ember Courts
ember_courts.description: A realm of fire ruled by salamander nobles from an obsidian palace.

exposure.name: heat
exposure.warn: The air shimmers and so do you. Get back to the palace.
exposure.relief: The palace's cool stone takes the heat out of you.

ec_landing.name: The Rift Steps
ec_landing.description: Steps of black glass where the rift lets out. Heat beats up from everything.

features.rift: Back through it, the Emberwaste's caldera.

ec_gate.name: The Ash Gate
ec_gate.description: A gate of obsidian, guarded by a salamander in gold armour.

ec_court.name: The Court of Embers
ec_court.description: A throne room of black glass and fire. Salamander nobles whisper behind fans.

ec_salon.name: The Duchess's Salon
ec_salon.description: Silk cushions on obsidian. The Ashen Duchess holds court of her own here.

ec_ring.name: The Ember Ring
ec_ring.description: A duelling ring of white-hot sand. Nobles watch from the shade.

ec_clockgate.name: The Clockwork Gate
ec_clockgate.description: A round door of brass gears set in the palace wall, turning slowly. It doesn't belong here.

features.gears: Brass, cold even here. Beyond them, a dead-still plain of metal.

ec_gardens.name: The Magma Gardens
ec_gardens.description: Gardens of glass flowers growing beside rivers of lava.

ec_flows.name: The Lava Flows
ec_flows.description: Stepping stones across a lava river. They sink a little when you stand on them.

trap.name: a sinking stepping stone
trap.hit: A stone sinks under you and the lava licks your legs.
trap.avoid: You hop from stone to stone without stopping.

sign.name: river
sign.text: The lava river ahead is crossed by stepping stones. They sink if you stand still.

ec_pavilion.name: The Ashen Duke's Pavilion
ec_pavilion.description: A pavilion of smoke and red silk. The Ember Crown sits on a cushion, stolen.

features.cushion: The crown's cushion, embroidered with the Duke's own arms.

ember_crown.name: Ember Crown
ember_crown.description: A crown of black glass with a fire burning in it. One of three relics.

ruuk.name: Ruuk
ruuk.label: Gatekeeper
ruuk.description: a salamander in gold armour, with a halberd
ruuk.details: A salamander in gold armour, with a halberd.

hounds.text: The Duke's magma hounds roam the gardens. Five of them, and the Court will notice you.

aszh.name: Vizier Aszh
aszh.label: Vizier
aszh.description: a thin salamander with a voice like a fuse
aszh.details: A thin salamander with a voice like a fuse.

crown.text: The Ashen Duke has stolen the Ember Crown and sits in his pavilion with it. Take it back. Keep it, even: the Court would rather it was far from him. They say it opens a door, somewhere.

kalimar.name: the Ashen Duchess Kalimar
kalimar.label: Duchess
kalimar.description: a salamander in a gown of living flame
kalimar.details: A salamander in a gown of living flame.

duel.text: My champion, Sir Calder, has never lost a duel in the Ember Ring. Beat him, and the whole Court will know your name. Run, and the whole Court will know that too.

calder.name: Sir Calder Ash
calder.label: Champion
calder.description: a salamander knight with a blade of white fire
calder.details: A salamander knight with a blade of white fire.

magma_hound_1.name: Magma Hound
magma_hound_1.label: Hound
magma_hound_1.description: a hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing
magma_hound_1.details: A hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing.

magma_hound_2.name: Magma Hound
magma_hound_2.label: Hound
magma_hound_2.description: a hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing
magma_hound_2.details: A hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing.

magma_hound_3.name: Magma Hound
magma_hound_3.label: Hound
magma_hound_3.description: a hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing
magma_hound_3.details: A hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing.

magma_hound_4.name: Magma Hound
magma_hound_4.label: Hound
magma_hound_4.description: a hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing
magma_hound_4.details: A hound of cooling lava, cracked and glowing.

cinder_guard_1.name: Cinder Guard
cinder_guard_1.label: Guard
cinder_guard_1.description: one of the Duke's guards, in armour of cinders
cinder_guard_1.details: One of the Duke's guards, in armour of cinders.

ashen_duke.name: the Ashen Duke
ashen_duke.label: Duke
ashen_duke.description: a salamander lord, grey with ash, smiling
ashen_duke.details: A salamander lord, grey with ash, smiling.

ember_rapier.name: Ember Rapier
ember_rapier.description: Sir Calder's rapier, burning white. In the heat it's quicker than thought.

obsidian_mail.name: Obsidian Mail
obsidian_mail.description: Plates of black glass on chain. Heavy, cool, and very hard. +1 Vigor.

ember_court.name: The Ember Court
ember_court.description: The salamander nobility. They admire a duel and despise a coward.

rules.note: You fled a fight. The Court saw.

caldera-rift.name: the caldera rift
caldera-rift.depart: You walk into the tear in the air, and the heat doubles.
caldera-rift.arrive: {actor} steps out of the rift onto black glass.

courts-rift.name: the caldera rift
courts-rift.depart: You step back through the rift.
courts-rift.arrive: {actor} steps out of the rift into the caldera.

clockwork-gate.name: the Clockwork Gate
clockwork-gate.depart: The gears turn, and turn, and you're through.

kill.goal: Kill five magma hounds in the Magma Gardens.

back.goal: Tell Ruuk: ASK RUUK ABOUT HOUNDS.

kill.goal: Beat Sir Calder in the Ember Ring. Don't run.

back.goal: Tell the Duchess: ASK KALIMAR ABOUT DUEL.

kill.goal: Kill the Ashen Duke in his pavilion, past the lava flows.

back.goal: Show the Vizier: ASK ASZH ABOUT CROWN.

effects.text: Aszh bows low. "Keep it far from here. There's a sealed door in a drowned city of yours with a crown-shaped hollow in it. Funny, that."

reputation.note: You took back the Ember Crown.
